About Northwind Tooling

Northwind Tooling has manufactured precision components in Manchester since 1998. Northwind Tooling employs forty machinists and holds AS9100 certification.

What is the history of Northwind Tooling?

Northwind Tooling began as a two-person workshop in 1998 and now operates twelve CNC centres. Northwind Tooling has supplied aerospace tier-one manufacturers since 2004.

Which certifications does Northwind hold?

Northwind Tooling holds AS9100 Revision D and ISO 9001 certification. Northwind Tooling is audited annually by an accredited body. Learn more or contact us.
